name: dsh-cookie-pruner
description: DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* cookie 累积（HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed 启动崩溃）缓解插件。限制 cookie 生命周期、自动清理最旧的认证 cookie，并提供应用内面板一键清理（保留最近 5 条）。 / Mitigates the DSH desktop dsh-auth-* cookie pile-up (HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed) bug: caps cookie lifetime, auto-prunes oldest auth cookies, and serves an in-app dashboard with a one-click clean (keep newest 5).
